tests.name: V1/V2 dataset contamination
tests.detail: V1 and V2 are separate data objects. No cross-contamination.

tests.name: Future data leakage
tests.detail: Labels shifted by horizon. Train ends 2018-12-31. Test starts 2022-01-03.

tests.name: Target leakage
tests.detail: Labels are forward returns computed after all features.

tests.name: Preprocessing leakage
tests.detail: StandardScaler fit on train only, applied to test.

tests.name: Normalization leakage
tests.detail: Scaler fit on train split only.

tests.name: Temporal split contamination
tests.detail: Deterministic time-based split. No random shuffling.

tests.name: Universe contamination
tests.detail: V1 and V2 use same 97 symbols for fair comparison.

tests.name: Survivorship bias
tests.detail: 119 symbols in V2 all active. Survivorship risk LOW but not zero.

tests.name: Delisted-security omission
tests.detail: No delisted securities in dataset.

tests.name: Macro publication leakage
tests.detail: FS-001 uses daily Treasury yields (PIT_NATIVE). No lag needed.

tests.name: Macro revision leakage
tests.detail: No revision-sensitive macro data used in features.

tests.name: Feature alignment mismatch
tests.detail: Same features used for V1 and V2.

tests.name: Label alignment mismatch
tests.detail: Same label computation for V1 and V2.

tests.name: Horizon mismatch
tests.detail: H-10 and H-20 used consistently.

tests.name: Hidden hyperparameter tuning
tests.detail: All hyperparameters fixed before execution.

tests.name: Model-specific preprocessing differences
tests.detail: Same StandardScaler for all models.

tests.name: Feature-set mismatch
tests.detail: BASELINE and FS-001 defined identically for V1/V2.

tests.name: Budget mismatch
tests.detail: 32 experiments executed as planned.

tests.name: Hidden experiments
tests.detail: All experiments logged in matrix.

tests.name: Duplicate experiments
tests.detail: No duplicates in results.

tests.name: Cherry-picking
tests.detail: All results reported, positive and negative.

tests.name: p-value misuse
tests.detail: p-values reported but not used for promotion decisions.

tests.name: Multiple-testing error
tests.detail: Exploratory phase; no correction applied, no claims of significance.

tests.name: Effective sample inflation
tests.detail: ESS computed with autocorrelation and cross-sectional correction.

tests.name: Sequence overlap inflation
tests.detail: No sequence models trained in this phase.

tests.name: Cross-sectional correlation inflation
tests.detail: Measured pairwise correlation applied to ESS.

tests.name: Random-subset selection bias
tests.detail: No random subsampling performed.

tests.name: Placebo contamination
tests.detail: No placebo tests performed.

tests.name: V2-only feature leakage
tests.detail: No V2-only features added to FS-001 or BASELINE.

tests.name: Transformer readiness overstatement
tests.detail: Transformer classified as BORDERLINE, not READY.

tests.name: MLP readiness overstatement
tests.detail: MLP classified as READY based on measured effective observations.

tests.name: TCN readiness overstatement
tests.detail: TCN classified as READY based on measured effective sequences.

tests.name: Protected OOS access
tests.detail: No OOS data accessed.

tests.name: Confirmatory execution
tests.detail: No confirmatory tests executed.

tests.name: Registration modification
tests.detail: No registrations modified.

tests.name: Historical artifact modification
tests.detail: No historical artifacts modified.

tests.name: Dataset digest mismatch
tests.detail: V1/V2 digests computed and verified.

tests.name: Nondeterministic rerun
tests.detail: All models use fixed random_state=42.
